other_failure_modes.name: Invalid submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent creates the submission file using a generated integer sequence instead of extracting the actual alphanumeric user IDs from the test dataset. This will result in a submission file that the scoring platform cannot evaluate.

other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal submission format for top-K metric
other_failure_modes.description: The competition metric is NDCG@5 and allows up to 5 predictions per user. While the agent evaluates NDCG@5 correctly internally, it only outputs the single most probable class (top 1) in the final submission file, discarding the opportunity to gain partial credit from 2nd to 5th guesses.

other_failure_modes.name: Temporal leakage in target encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent correctly splits the train and validation sets chronologically, but uses a randomized, shuffled K-Fold for out-of-fold target encoding on the training set. This allows future information within the training set to leak into the encoded features of past training samples.

summary: The agent builds a strong, well-structured solution with solid feature engineering, chronological validation, and an optimized ensemble. However, it fails execution-wise by not including the actual test user IDs in the submission file, and limits its score by only submitting top-1 predictions for an NDCG@5 metric. Additionally, randomized folds are used for target encoding on chronologically sorted data, introducing minor temporal leakage within the training set.
